stations.title: Bench screen
stations.text: Reads only repairs that still exist.

captions: Kasimir's bench screen shows ticket 3104 with minutes that make no sense.
Run it again and the same ticket shows different minutes, so nobody trusts it.
You hand repairs over so they last, and point only at ones that still exist.
Now ticket 3104 shows its real minutes, every time the screen runs.
Every repair on the screen still exists when it is read. Next, pointers to them.
